workflow.name: Qualify and book Facebook leads with ElevenLabs voice calls, Cal, Supabase, Slack and Gmail
workflow.description:
## How it Works
As soon as a new lead fills out your form through facebook ads, the data gets sent to n8n immediately and saved to Supabase. Then an outbound call gets triggered instantly to qualify the lead and book a meeting if applicable. As soon as this step is completed, a slack and email notification is sent to the team

## Set up steps
1. download and import workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials for Facebook, Eleven Labs, Cal, Supabase, Slack and Gmail
3. Run workflow node by node and edit accordingly

## Requirements
1. Facebook Account: Includes facebook ads account, business page, Facebook leads form
2. Eleven Labs Account
3. Cal Account
4. Supabase Account
5. Slack Account
6. Gmail Account

## Who this is for

This is for any business running facebook ads and wants to qualify leads and book appointment with qualified leads using voice agents.

parameters.content:
## Qualify and Book leads Instantly with Eleven Labs and Cal

### How it works
As soon as a new lead fills out your form through facebook ads, the data gets sent to n8n immediately and saved to Supabase. Then an outbound call gets triggered instantly to qualify the lead and book a meeting if applicable. As soon as this step is completed, a slack and email notification is sent to the team


### Requirements
1. Facebook Account: Includes facebook ads account, business page, Facebook leads form
2. Eleven labs Account
3. Cal Account
4. Supabase Account
5. Slack Account
6. Gmail Account


### Set up steps
1. Download and import workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials for Facebook, Eleven Labs, Cal, Supabase, Slack and Gmail
3. Run workflow node by node and edit accordingly including facebook form, supabase, eleven labs, slack and Gmail


### Who this is for
This is for any business running facebook ads and wants to qualify leads and book appointment with qualified leads using voice agents.

## Workflow A: Lead Intake & Outbound Call Trigger

Fires real-time when a new Facebook lead arrives. Saves the lead, then initiates an AI voice call within seconds.

## Workflow B: Post-Call Analysis & Team Notification

1. Listens for post-call webhook from ElevenLabs
2. Extracts call analysis (qualification, booking, transcript, summary)
3. Updates the lead row with full call data
4. Branches based on appointment booking outcome
5. Sends rich Slack message + Email notification with summary and transcript
